title: Settings
description: Workspace profile, language and account information.

general.title: General
general.legalNameHint: Contact support to change the legal entity.
general.defaultLanguageHint: Used for emails and new agents.
general.timezoneHint: Used for analytics, reports and dates in the dashboard.

notifications.personalHint: Choose which updates you receive. Topics disabled for the whole workspace cannot be turned back on here.
notifications.workspaceHint: Defaults for every member and for messages sent to callers. Mandatory billing, legal and security notices always stay on.

groups.workspaceHint: Updates sent to members of this workspace.
groups.callerHint: Confirmations and offers sent to your callers after a conversation.

notifications.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
notifications.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change workspace defaults.

types.GRACE_PERIOD_FINAL_DAY: Last day of the grace period

senderBanner.missing: Emails to guests are sent from your own email system, which is not set up yet. <link>Set it up on the Integrations page</link>
senderBanner.connected: Emails to guests are sent from {sender}. <link>Change it on the Integrations page</link>

branding.title: Email appearance
branding.description: Logo, accent color and footer in the emails sent to your guests.
branding.logoHint: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, up to 256 KB. Without a logo, your business name is shown.
branding.logoInvalid: The logo must be PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG and at most 256 KB.
branding.colorHint: The color of the bar at the top of the email.
branding.footerHint: For example your address, phone number or opening hours. Shown at the bottom of every email.

templates.title: Emails to guests
templates.description: Rewrite the emails in your own style. Fields in curly braces are replaced with the real details when sending.
templates.senderMissing: These emails are not sent until an email system is set up on the Integrations page.
templates.subject: Subject
templates.bodyHint: Separate paragraphs with an empty line.
templates.fieldsHint: Fields are replaced with the real details when sending, for example {example} becomes “Anna Kovacs”.
templates.unknownFields: Unknown field: {fields}. Use the buttons above or correct the field name.

webhooks.title: Outbound webhooks
webhooks.description: Send signed event notifications to your own systems when calls, bookings and contacts change.
webhooks.urlHint: Must use HTTPS on port 443 and resolve to a public address.
webhooks.secretOnce: Copy the signing secret now. For your security it will not be shown again.
webhooks.verifyHint: Verify every request by recomputing the HMAC signature before trusting its contents.
webhooks.disabled: Endpoint paused and pending deliveries stopped
webhooks.rotateDescription: The current secret stops working immediately. Update your endpoint with the new secret right away.
webhooks.deleteDescription: Deliveries to {url} will stop and their history will be removed.
webhooks.emptyDescription: Add an HTTPS endpoint to receive events in your CRM, helpdesk or data warehouse.
webhooks.failing: {count, plural, one {# failing delivery} other {# failing deliveries}}
webhooks.verifyBody: Each request carries a velyric-signature header with a Unix timestamp and an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the timestamp, a dot and the raw body. Reject requests older than five minutes.
webhooks.noDeliveriesDescription: Deliveries appear here as soon as a subscribed event occurs.

retention.configurableDescription: You can shorten how long these records are kept. Platform limits cannot be exceeded.
retention.fixedTitle: Fixed by law or platform policy
retention.fixedDescription: Billing, audit and consent records must be kept for statutory periods and cannot be changed.
retention.holdsNote: Active legal holds pause deletion for the affected records until they are released.

anchors.SOURCE_DELETED: Kept until the source is deleted

privacy.title: Privacy requests
privacy.description: Access, rectification, restriction and erasure requests from callers, with a 30-day response deadline.
privacy.createDescription: Requests without identity verification wait in verification until you confirm the requester.
privacy.verificationOptional: Leave empty if the requester has not been verified yet.
privacy.verifyDescription: Processing starts immediately. Erasure requests pause automatically when a legal hold applies.
privacy.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. This is kept in the audit trail.

completeDescription.EXPORT: Download the export first, send it to the requester through a secure channel, then record how it was delivered.
completeDescription.RECTIFY: Confirm that the contact details were corrected as requested.
completeDescription.RESTRICT: Completing a restriction also turns off caller memory for this contact.

privacy.emptyDescription: Requests recorded here or from a contact profile appear in this queue.

holds.title: Legal holds
holds.description: Holds prevent deletion of records needed for complaints, litigation or authority requests.
holds.createDescription: Erasure of the affected records pauses until an owner releases the hold.
holds.referenceHint: Copy the ID from the contact or call detail page.
holds.basisHint: For example: GDPR Art. 17(3)(e), pending court case.
holds.releaseDescription: Paused erasure requests resume immediately unless another hold still applies.
holds.releaseReason: Why is the hold no longer needed?
holds.empty: No legal holds have been placed.
